cfp.description: Submit your presentation for DevFest Toulouse 2026.
cfp.intro: DevFest Toulouse welcomes speakers from all backgrounds. Whether you're a beginner or an expert, your experience and passion matter. Submit a talk and share your knowledge with the community.
cfp.statusClosed: The CFP is now closed. Thank you for your submissions!
cfp.topicsDescription: Web, Cloud, Mobile, AI, Security, DevOps, Data, IoT... All tech topics are welcome. We also look for experience reports, inspiring talks and cross-cutting topics (culture, diversity, green IT).
